# Anwar Barayil

> Chennai-based sales and goal-setting trainer for colleges, institutes and companies. 27 years with multinationals in the Gulf (Gillette, P&G, Etisalat), rising from sales clerk to Trade Marketing Manager for the Middle East, then 20 years running his own businesses in the UAE and India.

Serves Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh first. Anywhere else in India or abroad when the host covers travel, stay and fee.

## Sessions
- Career talk: "Sales: a career worth choosing" (about 90 minutes)
- Goal-setting workshop (half day)
- Selling-skills course (1 to 2 days)
- Sales team training (custom, for companies)

## Evidence
- SAFI Institute, Calicut, Kerala, Nov 2026: 24 MBA/PGDM students rated the session; 96% want to learn selling skills from him.
